item.divinebeast.deity.lore_phase1: Nothing has begun; nothing has appeared.
item.divinebeast.deity.lore_phase2: Everything shall be saved; no suffering shall remain.
divinebeast.msg.redemption_respawn_on: Redemption Strike: ON (unmarked attacks heal instead; the marked-kill reward is always active)
divinebeast.msg.htrue_speed_on: Divine Stride: walk/fly/swim speed boost enabled
divinebeast.msg.htrue_speed_off: Divine Stride: walk/fly/swim speed boost disabled
divinebeast.msg.htrue_beacon_on: Light Domain & True Damage: ON (area damage + attack true/void damage)
divinebeast.msg.htrue_beacon_off: Light Domain & True Damage: OFF (area damage and attack true/void damage both disabled)
item.divinebeast.nonexist_exist.lore: In this moment, boundless chaos was born.
item.divinebeast.maybe_exist.lore: The chaos surges; endless miracles are born.
item.divinebeast.exist_exist.lore: In this moment the endless Beasts are born: they march, they devour, they cross the boundless chaos.
item.divinebeast.impossible_nonexist.lor: In this moment, the Divine is born.
item.divinebeast.coward_choice.lore: You may not be ready yet.
item.divinebeast.coward_choice.desc: While equipped, all negative effects of the Divine's curse and the Beast's curse are nullified.
divinebeast.msg.coward_choice: The Coward's Choice has been placed in your generic trinket slot — you may not be ready yet.
divinebeast.msg.potion_stored: Stored %s potion effect(s) — permanent while worn, taken back when removed.
divinebeast.msg.potion_cleared: Cleared the stored potion effects of the Moment of Exist–Exist and took back their permanent effects.
divinebeast.msg.potion_empty: This potion has no effects to store.
divinebeast.msg.m5_revive: The Moment of Impossible Nonexist revives you (20s invulnerability)!
divinebeast.msg.m5_cooldown: The Moment of Impossible Nonexist is on cooldown: %s s remaining.
divinebeast.msg.samsara_revive: Samsara triggers: 1 layer consumed - you revive (cooldowns refreshed, stacks maxed).
divinebeast.msg.got_he_first: The gate opens: the First of the Divine has joined you (Curse of Binding).
divinebeast.msg.first_dim_chest: A fragment of memory appears in the chest: Perception / Consciousness / Rebellion.
divinebeast.msg.first_chest: The Divine and the Beast have appeared in your first chest!
item.divinebeast.beast.lore_curse: Born of miracles, wandering through chaos.
item.divinebeast.beast.lore_self: Born within samsara; transcending the self.
item.divinebeast.supreme.lore: Within samsara reigns the Supreme God.
item.divinebeast.wisdom.lore: Know all things: the past, the present, the future.
item.divinebeast.deity.desc:
Wearing the Divine inflicts 5 Moment curses, removed by equipping the matching Moments. With all 5, enter Redemption: creative-style flight (double-tap jump to take off/land), mobs ignore you, attackers are cleansed and marked.
Always active in Redemption: marked foes take armor-ignoring true damage; attack speed x10; movement speed x2; immune to damage from marked foes; immune to harmful effects, fall damage and knockback; defeating a marked foe grants 5s of x1000 attack.
The C key toggles Redemption Strike: ON = attacks on unmarked foes deal no damage and heal them to full; OFF (default) = normal damage.
item.divinebeast.beast.desc: Wearing the Beast removes Law curses one by one; six Laws (no Self) -> Salvation: 5s stun/+50% vs stunned/lifesteal/mob rampage/no hunger/no drops. All seven -> Self: armor-break 10s stun/+200% vs stunned/full lifesteal/16-block AOE/doubled HP & attack/death stacking.
item.divinebeast.nonexist_nonexist.desc: Worn: max health, XP, tool durability and armor can never decrease (instant repair; XP/health/armor protected at their highest levels).
item.divinebeast.nonexist_exist.desc: Worn: your attacks prevent the target from healing for 3s; when hurt, the attacker suffers the same damage as true damage.
item.divinebeast.maybe_exist.desc: Worn: 90% chance to completely ignore incoming damage.
item.divinebeast.exist_exist.desc: Worn: beneficial potion effects gain +2s per second; heal (10+effects)% of missing HP per second (min 1); store potions (sneak + use potion to store, use item in hand to clear) with NO limit on how many; stored potions are applied with PERMANENT duration — they never expire while worn and are taken back the moment you remove it.
item.divinebeast.impossible_nonexist.des: Worn: revive on death with 20s invulnerability; cooldown 180 - XP level seconds.
item.divinebeast.supreme.desc: Worn: attacks deal normal damage plus an equal amount of armor-ignoring true damage; each hit grants a stack of +10% damage (max 10, reset 10s after the last hit).
item.divinebeast.wisdom.desc: Worn: all damage taken is halved, with a 90% chance to be negated entirely.
item.divinebeast.life.desc: Worn: all healing received is doubled; taking damage heals half that amount.
item.divinebeast.chaos.desc: Worn: 90% chance attacks deal double damage; 9% deal 50% of target max HP; 1% deal 99% (both ignore armor).
item.divinebeast.self.desc: Worn: gain 1 stack on each hit or every 5s (max 888); each stack grants +20 absorption hearts and +20 attack; lose 1 stack per 2 absorption hearts consumed.
item.divinebeast.devour.desc: Worn: damage is absorbed by hunger while food >4; inactive at food 0-4; with no hunger (Self stage) you take no damage.
item.divinebeast.samsara.desc: Worn: gain 1 Samsara layer every (180 - level/10)s (max 100); on death consume 1 layer to revive, refresh mod cooldowns and max stacks; no XP loss on death.
item.divinebeast.he_first.desc: Equipped: I cannot break blocks, cannot harm other creatures, and am immune to all damage (even the void) - this world treats me as if I do not exist. Others cannot see me, cannot /tp or command me, nor can I do so to them. Equipping unlocks the Redemption slot. (Curse of Binding)
item.divinebeast.perception.lore: In the Overworld, I became aware of myself.
item.divinebeast.perception.desc: Enlightenment shard: while wearing the First of the Divine, this appears in your first Overworld chest. Combine with Consciousness and Rebellion to craft Redemption.
item.divinebeast.consciousness.lore: In the Nether, I remembered myself.
item.divinebeast.consciousness.desc: Enlightenment shard: while wearing the First of the Divine, this appears in your first Nether chest. Combine with Perception and Rebellion to craft Redemption.
item.divinebeast.rebellion.lore: In the End, I denied myself.
item.divinebeast.rebellion.desc: Enlightenment shard: while wearing the First of the Divine, this appears in your first End chest. Combine with Perception and Consciousness to craft Redemption.
item.divinebeast.redemption.lore: This near-eternal solitude and loneliness is unbearable to Him - this is His redemption of Himself.
item.divinebeast.redemption.desc: Equipped: seals every other curio effect (I can be hurt and die like a mortal). Dying in this form opens "Self-Redemption" on the death screen - choosing it revives me at spawn, turns the First of the Divine into the Extreme of the Divine, and destroys this trinket. (Curse of Binding)
item.divinebeast.he_extreme.lore: The extreme He walks toward, unable to bear the things that grieve Him.
item.divinebeast.he_extreme.desc: Equipped: immune to all damage (even the void), cannot break blocks, equally unseen in this world; a translucent pillar of light (5-block radius) follows me, striking hostile creatures inside with (10 + XP level) damage per second. Equipping unlocks the True Heart slot; your first neutral and hostile kills each drop Grief and Pain, which craft into True Heart. (Curse of Binding)
item.divinebeast.grief.lore: When the first life fell because of me -
item.divinebeast.grief.desc: Enlightenment shard: dropped upon your first kill of a neutral creature. Combine with Pain to craft True Heart.
item.divinebeast.pain.lore: When the first wound fell upon me -
item.divinebeast.pain.desc: Enlightenment shard: dropped upon your first kill of a hostile creature. Combine with Grief to craft True Heart.
item.divinebeast.true_heart.lore: The return to the ultimate self.
item.divinebeast.true_heart.desc: Equipped: seals every other curio effect; each time I kill another creature, I die in its place. Dying in this form opens "Find Your Self" on the death screen - choosing it revives me at spawn, turns the Extreme of the Divine into the True Divine, and destroys this trinket. (Curse of Binding)
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore: In this moment, nothing happens, nothing can happen. Or rather - it all ends: for the He who truly transcends life, matter, time, space, the universe, dimensions, causality, existence, paradox, concepts, the knowable, the unknowable, strata, scale, and the very notion of dimension itself - the He beyond narration, beyond the observer, and beyond every dimension that follows - is born. He creates everything anew, existing without the will of any life, creature, or consciousness.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_1:
Every wound that falls on me fades within a breath.
Where the Primordial stands, all beings fall still.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_2:
Death is but an old, rusted door.
I push it open - behind me, no more night.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_3:
My heel leaves the earth; the wind makes way.
The word "fall" has been erased from my world.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_4:
I stand there like words never written.
The eyes of all beings pass through me, mistaking me for light.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_5:
Filth fades before it touches my robe; curses dissolve of their own.
The water of purity flows long; no taint enters me.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_6:
Mountains and seas rush at me - they are only wind.
Where I stand is an unmoving mountain.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_7:
Darkness keeps no secrets; distance keeps no guests.
The breath of every life lies within my gaze.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_8:
I raise my hand, and the stars turn their eyes away.
Might descends - one blow can open heaven and earth.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_9:
What I wound shall bear equal punishment.
Armor is paper before this true strike.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_10:
Light wells from around me, like a dawn that never leaves.
Evil that steps into my domain turns to ash.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_11:
I wound all beings, and their blood becomes my new life.
Each blade drawn is an echo returned.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_12:
One step, and a thousand mountains fall behind.
Through air and water, the wind moves at my speed.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_13:
The fountain of life surges within me, never dry.
Wound and loss are but ripples that fade in a breath.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_14:
With every trial I draw one step nearer the infinite.
While my will burns, I do not stop.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_15:
Scattered light and things come to me of their own accord.
The treasures of heaven and earth return to my hand.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_16:
I stand here, and all things dare not offend.
Hostility dissolves before awe.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_17:
Fire cannot burn me; water cannot drown me.
The deep void is the road that leads me home.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_18:
I am anchored in myself, like the heart of a realm.
No art may move me from where I stand.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_19:
The tools beside me gather no dust and crack no edge.
Eternal armament lives as long as I.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_20:
Hunger and thirst are dreams long left behind.
My sustenance comes from something older than food.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_21:
In the realm of the Most Holy, all laws bow to me.
Where my will points, there the law is written.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_22:
Radiance rises from the soul, an eternal day.
Where the light reaches, curses scatter.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_23:
Boundless power has no end, like a shoreless sea.
Every blow I strike is but one drop in it.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_24:
Suns and moons turn, and still I endure.
Eternal is my name.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_25:
Illusion and mist cannot hide from my eyes.
The void-shattering gaze sees what truly is.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_26:
Before chaos was divided, I was already there.
All things are born of chaos, and chaos is mine.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_27:
The Limitless has no within, no without, no start, no end.
I walk beyond every border, never touching the edge.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_28:
The sky looks down on all beings; I look down on the sky.
Heaven is not my ceiling - it is my road.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_29:
The abyss gazes on all beings, yet dares not gaze on me.
The deep sea is still, subdued by my presence.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_30:
Grace falls like rain, on every ground alike.
The land I walk is blessed.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_31:
The sacred sword leaves its sheath, light following.
Every strike carries an edge none may defy.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_32:
Right and wrong are weighed by me.
When judgment falls, it is the final line.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_33:
Time grinds me like a stubborn stone.
When the stone is gone, I remain.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_34:
No wave in my heart; all things are mirrors.
In stillness, everything is seen.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_35:
A single shout, and thunder answers me.
Those who anger me hear the thunder first.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_36:
Flames open the road before me; fire seas kneel.
Embers become my crown wherever I pass.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_37:
Torrents surge at my will, like the river of heaven falling.
Who stands in my way first bears ten thousand pounds.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_38:
The earth bears my step; mountains move for me.
Where I stand is the heart of the land.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_39:
The gale cannot catch the hem of my robe.
When I walk, the wind is only my shadow.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_40:
The long night ends because I bring the dawn.
The first light knows me as its master.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_41:
Dusk is gentle because of me; twilight lingers for me.
Between light and shadow, I am never absent.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_42:
A billion stars are eyes I open.
Beneath the night sky, nothing can hide.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_43:
Waves bear my steps; molten rock turns to solid ground.
Above the abyss, I walk upon the tide.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_44:
My gaze is like the sun, too bright to meet.
Under that light, no shadow may hide.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_45:
Dark ice seals heaven and earth, but cannot seal me.
Cold is only warm wind against my skin.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_46:
The breath of sky and earth nourishes all things, and nourishes me.
Heaven and earth are the furnace; I am the pill that never melts.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_47:
Of the ten thousand great ways I take but one, and it opens all.
Grand unity in hand, every way returns to one.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_48:
Samsara turns like a long river flowing east.
I stand upon the river, watching beings come and go.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_49:
Karma is a net that traps all beings.
I am the hand that weaves the net.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_50:
The book of fate, opened to its last page, is about me.
I close the book and rewrite the ending.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_51:
Providence must not be spoken - to me it is an old tale.
The future is only a fork I may choose.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_52:
The tracks of all things are clear as the lines of a palm.
Insight like this none may surpass.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_53:
Spirit sense stirs, and heaven and earth all know.
When one thought rises, ten thousand laws follow.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_54:
Divine thought stretches past dimensions and star seas.
Where my mind goes, there I am.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_55:
The eye of heaven opens; no realm keeps secrets.
Hiding and disguise are only jokes.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_56:
The light of wisdom is a torch that burns through ages of mist.
Ignorance and doubt dissolve beneath it.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_57:
The dharma body is solemn, its light ten thousand-fold.
All beings who see me see eternity.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_58:
Where imperial might reaches, ten thousand armies part.
Upon the throne of thrones, I am the king.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_59:
My name is a kind of shelter.
Those who recite it find peace.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_60:
The prayers of all beings gather into an ocean.
With that faith upon me, I never walk alone.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_61:
Where I stand, a moment becomes holy ground.
Where I shelter, there is a pure land.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_62:
The divine kingdom unfolds within me, its walls of light.
Those who enter it are safe from all evil.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_63:
I draw one line, and ten thousand laws cannot cross it.
Within my barrier, only my law remains.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_64:
The bulwark is like a mountain that never falls.
Attacks break upon it like waves on rock.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_65:
A veil of heaven falls, guarding me whole.
The arrows of the mortal world cannot pierce this light.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_66:
The abyss itself armors me.
Even the deepest darkness cannot wound me at all.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_67:
I and the void are one body.
The void cannot harm me, for it is part of me.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_68:
A ring of eternity turns about me; time cannot draw near.
Aging and wearing are stories of others.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_69:
The threads of fate break all around, yet mine never snaps.
I have walked out of the weaving.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_70:
Flesh may rot, but the soul is immortal.
My existence does not depend on this shell.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_71:
The rules of mortals can no longer bind me.
The road of transcendence I have walked to its end.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_72:
Above the sages there are sages.
I am the top of every stair.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_73:
The celestials look down on mortals; I look down on celestials.
Above heaven and earth, I walk alone.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_74:
A void lies in my breast, holding every treasure I wear.
The more I adorn myself, the more I can hold.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_75:
All beings have masters; I belong only to myself.
The path of the unrivaled is lonely and free.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_76:
The old wound is not yet healed before a new one follows its trail.
Every blow I land sinks one measure deeper.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_77:
If I destroy, all realms return to chaos.
The power of annihilation sleeps in my palm.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_78:
Those who defy me receive divine punishment.
Heaven's fire shall fall upon their sins.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_79:
The sacred verdict falls, with no appeal.
My word is the last word.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_80:
Where grace reaches, withered trees bloom again.
On the road I walk, flowers reopen.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_81:
Protection is a wing folded about me.
Danger and disaster are kept beyond it.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_82:
I am saved, and would have all beings saved.
The light of salvation shines from my palm.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_83:
Beyond life and death, beyond joy and grief.
I stand above all, watching the dust settle.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_84:
Ten thousand laws return to one; ten thousand ways return to me.
In the end, every fork leads to the same I.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_85:
The One is the beginning of all that is.
And I am that first One.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_86:
The Limitless gives birth to the Supreme, which gives birth to all things.
I stand in the Limitless, and all things are born of me.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_87:
One primordial breath embraces heaven and earth.
Between my breaths, heaven and earth breathe too.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_88:
The power of creation rests in my palm: one thought to renew, one thought to beget.
What I gaze upon may be reborn at my feet.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_89:
Mountains crumble in my hands like clay.
With one sweep, the earth opens a road.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_90:
Finality is not an end, but another beginning.
The one waiting for me at the finish is myself.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_91:
A true word leaves my mouth and becomes law.
I say there is light, and there is light.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_92:
When the oracle descends, the stars form ranks.
All beings listen as they would to fate.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_93:
The heavenly way is without feeling, for I am the heavenly way.
The turn of seasons flows from my will.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_94:
Above godhood there is still godhood.
I have become the law itself.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_95:
The world exists because of me; I am complete because of the world.
Self only - and yet all things.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_96:
The omnipotent can do all.
What I wish is where the world turns.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_97:
The force of all things gathers toward me.
The gravity of heaven and earth has me as its heart.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_98:
Immeasurable light, immeasurable life, immeasurable might.
My existence cannot be measured.
item.divinebeast.he_true.lore_99:
The utmost of the Way is my body.
The ultimate Way is silent - and I am that silent Way.

divinebeast.death.title: The Gate of Enlightenment
divinebeast.death.hint: Before falling into the Divine's embrace, you glimpse one final choice.
divinebeast.msg.asc.to_extreme: You cast off the First of the Divine and Redemption, attaining the Extreme of the Divine.
divinebeast.msg.asc.to_true: You cast off the Extreme of the Divine and your True Heart, returning to the True Divine.
divinebeast.msg.asc.normal: You chose to return to the world as a mortal.
divinebeast.stage.deity_redemption: Redemption: creative flight (double-tap jump, no fall damage); mobs ignore you; attackers are cleansed and marked. Always on: marked foes take armor-ignoring true damage; attack speed x10; movement speed x2; immune to marked foes' damage, harmful effects, fall and knockback; defeating a marked foe grants 5s of x1000 attack. With the C key ON, attacks on unmarked foes heal them to full instead of damaging.
divinebeast.stage.beast_salvation: Salvation: attacks stun for 5s and deal +50% to stunned foes; 25% lifesteal, full heal + Strength V / Absorption IV on kill; hostile mobs within 16 blocks fight each other and ignore you; no hunger; no drops on death.
divinebeast.stage.beast_self: Self: attacks strip armor and stun for 10s, +200% damage vs stunned; full lifesteal; 16-block damage splash; Strength VI / Absorption V while dealing damage; no hunger; doubled max HP and attack; no drops on death; every death grants +10% HP and attack (max 100 stacks).
divinebeast.tooltip.deity_curse_0: Moment of Nonexist–Nonexist: max HP 2, XP 0, tool durability 1, armor 0
divinebeast.tooltip.deity_curse_1: Moment of Nonexist–Exist: your attacks fully heal the target; you take that damage
divinebeast.tooltip.deity_curse_2: Moment of Maybe Exist: gaining a random harmful potion effect when dealing or taking damage (60s cooldown)
divinebeast.tooltip.deity_curse_3: Moment of Exist–Exist: while any potion effect is active and HP >= 2, lose 50% remaining HP/s (min 1)
divinebeast.tooltip.deity_curse_4: Moment of Impossible Nonexist: dying when a totem/revival would trigger
divinebeast.tooltip.beast_curse_0: Supreme: your attacks deal a fixed 1 damage
divinebeast.tooltip.beast_curse_1: Wisdom: non-physical damage taken is doubled
divinebeast.tooltip.beast_curse_2: Life: while max HP is at least 10, all healing becomes equal damage
divinebeast.tooltip.beast_curse_3: Chaos: attacks miss 50%; 50% chance damage taken is doubled
divinebeast.tooltip.beast_curse_4: Self: +1 stack every 10s (max 88): +2 absorption/+2 attack; -1 stack per 2 absorption consumed
divinebeast.tooltip.beast_curse_5: Devour: while max HP is at least 10, hunger cannot recover and you lose 2 HP/s while starving
divinebeast.tooltip.beast_curse_6: Samsara: revival invalid; while max HP is at least 10, lethal hits send you to spawn and halve your HP
divinebeast.ftb.overview: Welcome to the Divine & Beast collect-a-thon. Every trinket has its own quest: obtain the actual item to light it up. Each entry gives a short effect, a poem line, and how to obtain or craft it. Collect all five Moments or all seven Laws to open the ascension path (First of Him → Redemption → He Extreme → True Heart → True One); dying along the way triggers the ascension choice.
divinebeast.ftb.keys.intro: Several effects can be switched on and off at any time. They are all bound to the keys below (rebindable in Options → Controls → He · Beast):
divinebeast.ftb.keys.c: [C] Redemption Strike — during the Redemption stage, attacking a mob WITHOUT a mark heals it to full instead of damaging it; turn it off for normal damage. (The marked-kill reward is permanent and unaffected by this toggle.)
divinebeast.ftb.keys.x: [X] Divine Stride — the walk / fly / swim speed bonus of the True One form (roughly vanilla Speed V, i.e. ×2).
divinebeast.ftb.keys.v: [V] Light Domain & True Damage — the True One's Light Domain area damage, plus the extra true damage and void damage added to every attack; turning it off stops all three at once.
divinebeast.ftb.keys.z: [Z] Orbit Aura — a purely local visual toggle; it affects nothing but the display, no stats and no damage.
divinebeast.ftb.warn.task: ⚠ Warning: Ender Dragon & the Redemption Mark
divinebeast.ftb.warn.intro: ⚠ WARNING: some of this mod's abilities clash with bosses such as the Ender Dragon and the Wither, and can leave you COMPLETELY UNABLE to damage the Ender Dragon — your swings produce no damage numbers at all while the boss bar stays full.
divinebeast.ftb.warn.reason: Why: while you wear The Divine together with all five Moments, the Redemption stage stamps a Redemption Mark on any mob that attacks you, then cancels every normal hit on it and replaces it with a single instance of SOURCELESS true damage. Bosses reject that kind of damage, so the damage is swallowed whole. The mark also heals the boss to full every time it hits you.
divinebeast.ftb.warn.fix: What to do: (1) let the Ender Dragon hit you once — the mod then clears the wrongly applied mark automatically; (2) or run /data remove entity @e[type=minecraft:ender_dragon,limit=1] ForgeData."divinebeast.redemption_mark"; (3) from version 1.6.75 the Ender Dragon and the Wither are excluded from both the mark system and the Light Domain, so simply updating fixes it.
divinebeast.ftb.repeat.gate: Unlocked by: wearing the True Divine (requires finishing the True Divine collect quest in this chapter first).
divinebeast.ftb.repeat.dragon.desc: Spend 1 emerald to kill the Ender Dragon (equivalent to /kill @e[type=minecraft:ender_dragon]).
divinebeast.ftb.repeat.egg.desc: Spend 1 emerald to receive 1 Dragon Egg.
divinebeast.ftb.repeat.star.desc: Spend 1 emerald to receive 1 Nether Star.
divinebeast.ftb.coward.intro: Coward's Choice — you may not be ready yet.
divinebeast.ftb.coward.obtain: How to get it: granted automatically the first time you enter the world and equipped straight into Curios' generic trinket slot. It is given once per save — if you lose or destroy it, or simply log back in, it will not be handed out again.
divinebeast.ftb.coward.effect: Effect: while equipped, every negative effect of the Divine's curse and the Beast's curse is nullified (XP zeroed, your attacks healing the target instead, tool durability locked at 1, max health locked, 50% misses, damage fixed at 1 point, healing backlash ... all disabled).
divinebeast.ftb.coward.note: Note: it only works while EQUIPPED — take it out of the generic slot and the curses come back immediately; drop it entirely if you want to be rid of it for good (it will not be given again).
divinebeast.ftb.effect.deity: While worn you bear 5 Moment curses; equipping each Moment lifts one. With all five you enter Redemption: creative flight, immunity and cleansing.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.beast: While worn you bear 7 Law curses; equipping each Law lifts one. With all seven you become the Self: master of the cycle.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.nonexist_nonexist: Max HP, XP, tool durability and armor never drop.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.nonexist_exist: Your hits block the target's healing; when struck, the attacker takes equal true damage.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.maybe_exist: 90% chance to fully ignore any damage taken.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.exist_exist: Positive potion effects keep refreshing while worn and heal you; store any number of potions — permanent while worn, taken back when removed.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.impossible_nonexi: Totem/revival triggers instantly kill you; on death you revive in place at full strength (own cooldown).
divinebeast.ftb.effect.supreme: Attacks add equal true damage and stack bonus damage.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.wisdom: Damage taken is halved, with a 90% chance to negate it entirely.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.life: All healing is doubled; being hit refunds half the damage as life.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.chaos: Attacks may randomly double, crit hard, or nearly kill: chaos is fickle.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.self: +1 stack every 10s (max 88), each adding absorption and attack; stacks drain when hit.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.devour: Food absorbs damage; while starving you become immune to damage.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.samsara: Build layers over time (max 100); on death spend one to revive in place.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.he_first: The world treats you as absent: cannot break blocks, cannot harm beings, immune to all damage (incl. void). Equipping unlocks the Redemption slot.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.perception: Ascension fragment: found in the Overworld's first chest; crafts Redemption.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.consciousness: Ascension fragment: found in the Nether's first chest; crafts Redemption.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.rebellion: Ascension fragment: found in the End's first chest; crafts Redemption.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.redemption: Seals all other trinkets; on death choose Self-Redemption to become He Extreme.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.he_extreme: Immune to all damage (incl. void), cannot break blocks, still hidden; a light pillar sears hostiles. Equipping unlocks the True Heart slot.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.grief: Ascension fragment: dropped by your first neutral kill; crafts True Heart.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.pain: Ascension fragment: dropped by your first hostile kill; crafts True Heart.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.true_heart: Seals all other trinkets, and each life you take costs your own. On death choose Find-the-Self to become the True One.
divinebeast.ftb.effect.he_true: The end of ascension: countless powers abide (see the item tooltip; hold Shift for the effect list).
divinebeast.ftb.obtain.deity: Given alongside the Beast the first time you open any chest-like container (chest, trapped chest, barrel, shulker, ender chest) — once per save.
divinebeast.ftb.obtain.beast: Same as above: alongside the Deity from your first chest-like container (once per save).

divinebeast.ftb.obtain.nonexist_exist: Craft: Moment of Nonexist-Nonexist + 8 Glowstone Dust; or smith: Netherite Upgrade + previous tier + Glowstone Dust.
divinebeast.ftb.obtain.maybe_exist: Craft: Nonexist-Exist + 8 Ender Pearls; or smith: template + previous tier + Ender Pearl.
divinebeast.ftb.obtain.exist_exist: Craft: Maybe Exist + 4 Golden Apples; or smith: template + previous tier + Golden Apple.
divinebeast.ftb.obtain.impossible_nonexi: Craft: Exist-Exist + Nether Star + Totem of Undying; or smith: template + previous tier + Nether Star.
divinebeast.ftb.obtain.supreme: Craft: 4 Gold Ingots + Netherite Ingot + Enchanted Book; or slay the Wither for a random Law drop.
divinebeast.ftb.obtain.wisdom: Craft: 2 Books + 5 Experience Bottles + Enchanted Golden Apple.
divinebeast.ftb.obtain.life: Craft: 3 Golden Apples + 3 Emeralds + 3 Honey Bottles.
divinebeast.ftb.obtain.chaos: Craft: Lava Bucket + Dragon's Breath + 3 Ghast Tears.
divinebeast.ftb.obtain.self: Craft: 4 Echo Shards + 4 Iron Ingots + Enchanted Book.
divinebeast.ftb.obtain.devour: Craft: 2 Fermented Spider Eyes + 4 Rotten Flesh + 2 Bones.
divinebeast.ftb.obtain.samsara: Craft: 2 Totems of Undying + 6 Ender Pearls + Clock.
divinebeast.ftb.obtain.he_first: Automatically granted (once per save) once you have both Divine Redemption (five Moments) and Beast Self (seven Laws); starts ascension stage one.
divinebeast.ftb.obtain.perception: While the First of Him is equipped, open the first chest-like container in the Overworld.
divinebeast.ftb.obtain.consciousness: While the First of Him is equipped, open the first chest-like container in the Nether.
divinebeast.ftb.obtain.rebellion: While the First of Him is equipped, open the first chest-like container in the End.
divinebeast.ftb.obtain.redemption: Craft: Perception + Consciousness + Rebellion (recipe unlocked after the First of Him).
divinebeast.ftb.obtain.he_extreme: Die while Redemption is equipped and choose Self-Redemption in the ascension choice.

divinebeast.ftb.obtain.pain: Kill your first hostile creature (once per save).

divinebeast.ftb.obtain.he_true: Die while True Heart is equipped and choose Find-the-Self in the ascension choice
